execution.progress: One atomic paid examination; no escrow, ongoing labor or automatic retry. A cancelled pre-execution intention does not become a completed observation.

details.costs: One completed round and 0.5 energy after valid visible reach and bounds checks. No material, tools, plot or reservation. Invalid invocations do not begin or charge. A later new examination pays again.
details.effects: Private dated surface/clearance findings identify operation limitations separately from unknown physical properties. Bare ground is distinct from the general ordinary-soil moisture regime. No deeper substrate, concealed occupant or hidden resource information. No clearing, excavation, sampling, planting, material change, skill grant, food or reward. The atomic attempt has no resumable work or maintenance; no unperformed completion is recorded. Results are not silently refreshed and sharing requires real communication.
